ambient_events: Upstairs, somebody crosses a floor and a light fitting shivers.
The capped pipes behind the back wall knock twice and go quiet.
A pram goes past the window, the wheels loud on the paving.
Someone in the flats opposite pulls a curtain, considers the street, and lets it fall.
description: A neighbourhood shop with the plumbing of a laundrette and the fittings of nothing. Six capped stubs stand proud of the back wall in a neat row where the machines were, and the floor is tiled in a hardwearing grey that has outlasted three businesses. There is a counter by the door and a cashbox under it. The window looks straight out at the flats opposite, and the flats opposite look straight back.
name: Unit 3, Kessler Street
